remote_source_state: Modified working tree; source hashes match the published code commit.
source_hash_method: The source_identity algorithm in src/unilab/training/mix_benchmark.py, using sorted relative paths, individual file SHA-256 values, and Git-tracked XML files.

raw_study_artifacts.digest_method: SHA-256 of the sha256sum listing for all original .json/.jsonl paths under the study, prefixed ./ and sorted using LC_ALL=C; validation_evidence is excluded.

all_copied_raw_artifacts.note: Counts exclude this derived audit and authored Markdown documentation. Original JSON content was preserved.

all7_cleanup_checks.shared_memory_note: The supervising task observed no new shared-memory residuals; raw before/after shared-memory listings are not included in this archive.

limitations: Mechanical validation only: one confirmation training seed and four PPO iterations per run.
No training advantage, stable locomotion, or globally optimal ratio is established.
Checkpoints are omitted; their recorded SHA-256 values cannot be recomputed from this compact archive.
External simulator packages and native binaries were not copied; their hashes and installed versions remain in the original study provenance.
Isaac external workers, system libraries, and GPU drivers are not fully fingerprinted by the study.
